sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reduced: Q2 subscription and services guided to $565M to $645M, down from Q1's $584M (which itself was down 16% QoQ). The full-year adjusted expense range of $4.3B to $4.6B implies continued cost pressure. Revenue missed expectations ($1.4B vs ~$1.56B expected) and GAAP net loss of $394M was reported. Management's tone is defensive, focusing on cost cuts and market share rather than growth. The score is -0.50 because guidance was effectively lowered relative to the prior quarter's run rate, and the backward-looking miss reinforces the negative forward signal.

summary.revenue: Total revenue $1.4B, down 21% quarter over quarter, below the roughly $1.56B expected. Transaction revenue $756M. Subscription and services $584M, down 16%.
summary.eps: GAAP net loss $394M and EPS of -$1.49 against a small positive consensus.
summary.guidance: Q2 subscription and services guided to $565M to $645M. Tech, development and G&A expenses guided down 4% to 9% quarter over quarter, with $50M to $60M of restructuring charges. Full-year 2026 adjusted expenses $4.3B to $4.6B.
key_risks: Total crypto market cap and trading volumes both fell more than 20% quarter over quarter.
Institutional transaction revenue dropped 27% as low volatility cut hedging demand at Deribit.
Long-term fee compression acknowledged as a risk, with diversification the stated answer.
key_opportunities: We reached an all-time high in Coinbase crypto trading volume market share in Q1.
Crypto trading volumes have grown more than 50x in the last 7 years.
